name: stagger-list
title: Stagger list
description: A list whose items enter one after another when it scrolls into view, with a step, a cap on the wait and real list semantics that stay intact.
docs: Render it as ul or ol and give it li children; it adds no wrapper, and a ul or ol carries an explicit role="list", so assistive technology (Safari with VoiceOver included) still announces the list and its item count. Each child waits index times step milliseconds, never longer than maxDelay. Any element can be an item. The server renders every item visible; a list already on screen when the page hydrates stays as it is, one that mounts in the browser always plays. Reduced motion and print show every item at once.
